value.title: Отображаемая точность и исходный fix
value.meaning: Display accuracy is a metric radius with a3m floor only for eligible phone GPS; it does not mutate the fix and is not heading uncertainty or range to a target.
value.value_origin: Location.accuracy -> LocationDisplayAccuracy.meters -> status text and MapDrawable.updateLocation
value.units: Metres; phone GPS min3m; external/receiver streams/Network keep reported value.
actions: Compare display result with unchanged input fix.
conditions: Floor requires positive finite GPS accuracy, no external input, no receiver stream.
value.saved_state: Display transform stores no rewritten accuracy or provenance.
expectations: Phone1m displays3m while original remains1m; external1m remains1m.
Counterexample: displayed3m does not mean arrival tolerance3m or externally supplied accuracy was modified.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI, device, emulator, build or APK resource merge acceptance in this task.
